movie_title: These Were the Tallest Buildings Before Burj Khalifa
introduction: Before the Burj Khalifa in Dubai became the tallest building on earth, which buildings held the titl
lead_intro: Discover the history of some of the world's tallest buildings and their record-breaking heights.

quiz.question: Which building held the title of the tallest building on Earth before the Burj Khalifa in Dubai?
choices: Empire State Building in New York
quiz.answer: Empire State Building in New York
quiz.explanation: The Empire State Building in New York held the title before the Burj Khalifa in Dubai.

quiz.question: For how many years did the Empire State Building hold the title of the tallest building?
quiz.explanation: The Empire State Building held the title for 40 years before being replaced by the World Trade Center.

quiz.question: Which tower ended the Sears Tower's 25-year streak as the tallest building?
quiz.explanation: The Patronus Towers in Malaysia ended the Sears Tower's streak as the tallest building.

quiz.question: In which city did the Sears Tower hold the title of the tallest building?
quiz.explanation: The Sears Tower held the title in Chicago for nearly 25 years.

quiz.question: Which country houses the Taipei 101, one of the buildings that held the record for being the tallest?
quiz.explanation: The Taipei 101 is in Taiwan, one of the countries where height records were set.
